name: custom-api-models
description: Route WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy Code cloud model choices to your own OpenAI-compatible APIs, with an official / third-party switch

ENABLED.title: Model source
ENABLED.description: third-party or official. Empty = third-party. Default for new sandboxes; the models_switch tool or /models-official overrides it per sandbox.

PRESET.title: Preset
PRESET.description: Provider preset, e.g. bailian. Leave empty when BASE_URL is set.

API_KEY.title: API key
API_KEY.description: API key for the default provider
